title: Cellular gateway firmware versions MG 3.102 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new candidate cellularGateway firmware is now available on Fri, 01 Mar 2024
A new stable cellularGateway firmware is now available on Tue, 25 Jun 2024

Bug fixes: Fixed an issue that causes units to reboot during times of high traffic
Corrected an issue causing units in passthrough mode to drop outbound ESP traffic
Improvements to the functionality of Day-0 Zero-touch connectivity
Known issues: MG Identifier not included in Dashboard SNMP MIB
Dashboard reports SIM in MG41 as not inserted despite the device being online via Cellular
API Calls to MG21 returns "Not running configured version"
MG’s have yellow status on Organization > Overview when on Cellular

html:
Cellular gateway firmware versions MG 3.102 changelog

Bug fixes

  • Fixed an issue that causes units to reboot during times of high traffic
  • Corrected an issue causing units in passthrough mode to drop outbound ESP traffic
  • Improvements to the functionality of Day-0 Zero-touch connectivity

Known issues

  • MG Identifier not included in Dashboard SNMP MIB
  • Dashboard reports SIM in MG41 as not inserted despite the device being online via Cellular
  • API Calls to MG21 returns "Not running configured version"
  • MG’s have yellow status on Organization > Overview when on Cellular
